ko: 내가 매일 기쁘게 순례의 길 행함은
en: I'm rejoicing night and day, As I walk the pilgrim way For the hand of God in all my life I see

ko: 내가 주의 큰 복을 받는 참된 비결은
en: And the reason of my bless, Yes, the secret all is this That the Comforter abides with me.

ko: 좁은 길을 걸으며 밤낮 기뻐하는 것
en: He abides, He abides, Hallelujah He abides with me! I'm rejoicing night and day, As I walk the narrow way, For the comforter abides with me

ko: 전에 죄에 빠져서 평안함이 없을 때
en: Once my heart was full of sin, Once I had no peace within, Till I heard how Jesus died upon the tree

ko: 그 발 아래 엎드려 참된 평화 얻음은
en: Then I fell down at His feet, And there came a peace so sweet, Now the comforter abides with me

en: For the Spirit has control, Jesus satisfies my soul, That the Comforter abides with me

en: All my night was turned to day, All my burdens rolled away, Now the Comforter abides with me
